name: Bar residency rig (2026-10-01)
description: Josh's local-bar setup: the OK103 wash bar on the stand at the booth, and two Shehds 3W lasers mounted above the small dancefloor, pointing straight. laser_profile=feature runs the lasers as the main light (engines/laser_feature.py). ADDRESSING (Josh, 2026-10-01: a fresh rig, so the channels are laid out in order): wash bar 1-6, Laser L 7-18, Laser R 19-30 -- set each unit to that start address in its 6-/12-channel mode.
